project.name: ShipFlow (reactor)
project.description:
Aggregator POM for building the ShipFlow Maven modules together in dependency order: shipflow-plugin-api (no dependencies) → backend (depends on shipflow-plugin-api).
This aggregator is a convenience for a single top-down build (`mvn install` from the repo root). It is NOT required for day-to-day development: `backend/` keeps its own parent (spring-boot-starter-parent) and is fully buildable on its own — `cd backend && ./mvnw verify` works unchanged — as long as shipflow-plugin-api has already been `mvn install`ed into the local repository first (see Dockerfile's backend-builder stage and .github/workflows/ci.yml for where that install step runs in CI/Docker).
plugin-sdk/shipflow-plugin-archetype is intentionally NOT a module here: it packages Maven archetype resources (Velocity-templated files), not compiled Java, and has no build-order dependency on the other two modules — build/verify it independently, see plugin-sdk/README.md.
